description:
Business Development Manager ka kaam kya hota hai? In this video Ankur will explain to you the role of Business Development Manager along with all duties and responsibilities. So if you are exploring a career in BD, this video will give you a lot of info in simple Hindi.

You may say that Business Development is a branch of Sales, but it is technically a little different from sales. Though BD will also come with targets, the role of a BD is broader.

The video will also tell you about what education, qualification and skills are needed to do this work. This video is also a subtle training for growing into this role and building your career. Several insights are shared about this field of work.

The video goes into depths of what things you will do in this job in India and globally. It also gives you real life examples.

#BusinessDevelopment #Jobs #Focuslocus
